pages.text: The $(item)Resonite Shard$() is what every counterplayed anomaly leaves behind (radioactive ones never resolve, so they never pay out). Plain on its own, but the only feedstock for crystals.
Nine shards in a 3x3 press into one raw $(item)Resonite Crystal$(). Raw, it does nothing - no buff, no power. Its potential is sealed until it is analyzed.
Nine $(item)Resonite Shards$() yield one raw crystal.

Run a raw crystal through an $(item)Analyzer$(). Analysis rolls a $(o)grade$() (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary - higher is rarer) and a $(o)resonance$() (one random beneficial effect), then writes them in for good.

pages.title: Certified for Life
pages.text: Re-analyzing an already-analyzed crystal is safe: it keeps its grade and resonance rather than rerolling. (The certification stamp does not come off.) $(br)The resonance pool includes radiation resistance, a vitality boost, and a quickdraw boost.

pages.title: Carrying a Crystal
pages.text: An analyzed crystal works passively while it is $(o)in your inventory or worn in a Curios slot$(). $(br)$(li)$(o)Resonance:$() you continuously gain its effect, scaled by grade. Duplicate resonances don't stack - the strongest wins; different ones all apply. $(li)$(o)Power:$() it acts as a bottomless FE battery that never drains. Higher grades output more FE/t.
